history.p: Full translation transformer educational architecture, rich sequence-column detail. Source has THREE token positions -> token embeddings plus position encoding -> repeated encoder layer containing bidirectional self-attention and feed-forward -> final source-state matrix H. Target has FOUR shifted token positions -> token embeddings plus position encoding -> repeated decoder layer containing masked causal self-attention, cross-attention and feed-forward -> FOUR output probabilities/token slots. Final source H supplies K/V to cross-attention of EVERY decoder layer via common bus; queries originate within target path. Illustrate repeated layer with two shown instances or one detailed module plus repeat bracket, reserve ×L label. Input embeddings and position modules bottom aligned across both paths; separate right output column is welcome if composition suits. Matrices and tiny causal triangular grid, actual mechanism glyphs, no giant uniform-color panel. No labels/digits/operators. No one-to-one matching encoder intermediate levels to decoder levels. Make independent scientifically accurate design.
